Defect Title / Summary: Camera Permission False Negative Bug & Registration Showstopper
Steps to Reproduce:
1. In Android App Settings, grant Camera permission to StarWarsApp
2. Open app -> tap 'Create a new account'
3. Tap camera avatar icon to take profile photo
Expected Result: Live camera viewfinder activates immediately since permission is already granted
Actual Result: Screen displays: 'Camera permission is not granted'; user cannot take photo, blocking registration completely
Concrete Evidence / Proof / Log Referenc:
DEVICE SCREEN EVIDENCE:
Emulator displays red fallback text: 'Camera permission is not granted' even though Android permission dialog shows 'Allowed'. User is unable to advance.
Root Cause Analysis:
1. RegisterScreen.js#L30 hardcodes initial state to false (useState(false))
2. Camera.getCameraPermissionStatus() is never called on mount
3. React renders error view before async requestCameraPermission() finishes
4. On newer Android, requestCameraPermission() doesn't fire when pre-granted

Defect Title / Summary: User Data Committed Before Location Check Completes (Permanent Registration Lockout)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Fill valid registration form and photo
2. Tap Save -> Skip
3. When Android asks for Location, tap 'Don't allow' (Deny)
Expected Result: App handles denial gracefully; user data is not corrupted or prematurely registered
Actual Result: User is committed to MMKV before permission resolves; denial redirects to Login; retrying registration shows 'Email is already registered', locking user out
Root Cause Analysis: Data persistence is called prior to resolving the asynchronous requestLocationPermission() promise
Developer Fix / Actionable Code Remedy: Move Storage.setItem inside the successful resolution branch of the permission/registration chain; do not persist before checks finish

Defect Title / Summary: Mandatory Location Permission Blocks User Login (Hostile Access Gate)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Enter valid email and password on Login Screen
2. Deny location permission or turn off GPS
3. Tap LOGIN
Expected Result: User logs in successfully; location-based features degrade gracefully
Actual Result: User is strictly blocked from logging in; error toast: 'You must allow location permission on this app to login'
Concrete Evidence / Proof / Log Referenc:
TOAST EVIDENCE:
Toast alert: 'You must allow location permission on this app to login'. Login flow halts and button shows loading or resets without logging in.
Root Cause Analysis: LoginScreen.js#L114-116: fetchLogin() is nested inside requestLocationPermission().then(). Denying permission branches to error toast and aborts login
Developer Fix / Actionable Code Remedy: Decouple GPS location from authentication. Allow login to proceed and request location contextually when opening group maps

Defect Title / Summary: Landscape Screen Completely Unscrollable & UI Stuck (Missing ScrollView)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open LoginScreen or ProfileScreen
2. Rotate device to Landscape (Ctrl+Left Arrow)
3. Attempt to scroll down with finger/mouse
Expected Result: Content scrolls smoothly, allowing access to input fields and buttons below the fold
Actual Result: Screen cannot scroll; touch gestures produce no action; LOGIN button and Register link are cut off and unreachable
Concrete Evidence / Proof / Log Referenc:
LIVE EMULATOR TEST EVIDENCE:
In landscape mode (height ~360px), inputs fill the screen; Login button is pushed off-screen. Swiping vertically does nothing because no ScrollView exists.
Root Cause Analysis: LoginScreen/index.js and ProfileScreen/index.js wrap content in static <View> and <SafeAreaView> with flex: 1 and no <ScrollView>
Developer Fix / Actionable Code Remedy:
Wrap root containers in ScrollView:
<ScrollView contentContainerStyle={{ flexGrow: 1 }} showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
  <View style={styles.inputContainer}> ... </View>
</ScrollView>

Defect Title / Summary: Unconstrained Image Capture Size & Uncompressed Base64 Memory Bloat
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Capture photo on modern camera (e.g. 48MP+ sensor)
2. Register and create groups
3. Inspect MMKV storage payload
Expected Result: Photo is cropped (300x300), compressed (<200KB), and stored as a file path URI
Actual Result: Entire raw camera photo converted to massive Base64 string stored in MMKV, causing severe RAM bloat and Out-Of-Memory (OOM) crashes
Concrete Evidence / Proof / Log Referenc:
MMKV STORAGE EVIDENCE:
"photo": "/9j/4AAQSkZJRgABAQAAAQABAAD/4gHYSUNDX1BST0ZJ..." (String length: 150,000+ characters for a single user!). In groups with 10 members, FlatList crashes.
Root Cause Analysis: RegisterScreen.js#L187 reads raw snapshot with RNFS.readFile(filePath, 'base64') and saves full blob to storage and state
Developer Fix / Actionable Code Remedy: Crop images to avatar square (300x300), compress JPEG (<150KB), and persist only file paths (file:///data/.../avatar.jpg), never raw Base64

Defect Title / Summary: Orientation Change Distorts Layout & Pie Chart Due to Frozen Metrics
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open Group Home Screen with groups
2. Rotate device to Landscape
Expected Result: UI reflows dynamically; PieChart and cards scale proportionally to screen height/width
Actual Result: Bottom tab bar becomes giant (~120px); PieChart retains portrait width (400px), overflowing the 360px landscape height and distorting layout
Root Cause Analysis: Static Object.freeze on Dimensions.get('window') causes metrics to remain stale after orientation changes
Developer Fix / Actionable Code Remedy:
Replace static Metrics with React Native's dynamic hook:
const { width, height } = useWindowDimensions();

Defect Title / Summary: Insecure iOS TLS Configuration via NSAllowsArbitraryLoads = true (OWASP M3)
Expected Result: NSAllowsArbitraryLoads must be false; strict HTTPS enforced across network calls
Actual Result: NSAllowsArbitraryLoads is set to true, completely disabling Apple Transport Security TLS enforcement
Root Cause Analysis: Insecure App Transport Security configuration allows arbitrary plaintext HTTP traffic susceptible to MITM attacks
Developer Fix / Actionable Code Remedy: Set NSAllowsArbitraryLoads to false and enforce strict HTTPS domains

Developer Fix / Actionable Code Remedy: Create dedicated production keystore and inject keystore password via CI/CD environment variables

Defect Title / Summary: SWAPI Search Query Parameter Ignored on Static Mirror

const filtered = list.filter(i => i.name.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()));

Defect Title / Summary: Client-Side Password Complexity Enforcement on Login & Missing MaxLength
Steps to Reproduce:

3. Tap LOGIN
Expected Result: Login screen should not re-evaluate creation complexity regex; should only check password presence and send to auth service

Root Cause Analysis: Flawed authentication architecture where registration password creation rules are erroneously re-checked during login
Developer Fix / Actionable Code Remedy: Remove validatePassword check from handleLogin() in LoginScreen.js#L98
